svg.title: AI policy changes over time: pilot
svg.desc: One timeline from May 2025 to October 2026. Dot color identifies project. Dots above the central line indicate tightening, dots below indicate loosening, and dots on the line indicate a new policy baseline, mixed change, clarification, or no established direction. Distance from the line is qualitative, not a measured score. Numbered notes link to 28 reviewed revisions across 21 projects and show their Consent Policy Specificity domains.
svg.text: AI policy changes over time: pilot
28 reviewed revisions across 21 projects · source revision dates, May 2025–October 2026

g.text: Vertical distance is qualitative; nearby dates are spaced for readability. Exact dates appear below.

a.title: 1. curl: AI-use policy baseline, 2025-05-15; diff evidence
4. Linux kernel: AI guidance policy baseline, 2026-01-06; diff evidence
6. NumPy: new AI policy baseline, 2026-03-04; diff evidence
8. NumPy: clarified description restriction, 2026-03-07; diff evidence
11. Rust: exceptions to a restriction, 2026-06-17; diff evidence
12. Rust: meeting use and LLM-process restrictions removed, 2026-06-22; diff evidence
13. PyTorch: policy guidance reorganized, 2026-07-15; diff evidence
15. Linux kernel: attribution requirement simplified, 2026-08-03; diff evidence
16. Linux kernel: bug-finding procedure added, 2026-08-04; diff evidence
19. mise: restricted AI replies, 2026-10-02; diff evidence
20. PyTorch: relaxed content-labeling format, 2026-10-07; diff evidence
22. Nominatim: accountability and refusal option added; proof requirement removed, 2026-10-13; diff evidence
23. Linux kernel: attribution requirement removed, 2026-10-14; diff evidence
24. Meilisearch: contribution rule changed from disclosure to exclusion, 2026-10-15; diff evidence
25. XMTP: ban replaced with accountability requirements, 2026-10-15; diff evidence
27. Python-Markdown: expanded disclosure and template enforcement, 2026-10-19; diff evidence

2. Apache CouchDB: AI-generated material prohibited, 2025-06-13; merged PR diff
3. scikit-learn: AI disclosure added to policy and PR template, 2025-12-01; merged PR diff
5. Django: required AI disclosure and verification, 2026-01-08; merged PR diff
7. LLVM: exception for approved Bazel fixer bot, 2026-03-05; merged PR diff
9. Godot: AI agents must self-disclose, 2026-04-21; merged PR diff
10. Cilium: PR template links policy and asks what contributor checked, 2026-05-26; merged PR diff
14. Homebrew: AI authorship disallowed and human review responses required, 2026-07-29; merged PR diff

18. pandas: human-written communications and specific disclosure required, 2026-08-14; merged PR diff
21. Apache DataFusion: contribution and review guidance revised, 2026-10-08; merged PR diff

a.text: Added AI guidance for code, reports and translation.
Prohibited AI-generated code, docs and other materials.
Added AI disclosure for code, tests, docs and research.
Added assistant guidance, human sign-off and attribution.
Required AI disclosure and output verification in PRs.
Added policy for contributions, content and agents.
Made an exception for the approved Bazel fixer bot.
Clarified the ban on AI-written comments and descriptions.
Required AI agents to disclose in issues and PRs.
Code · Content · Autonomous / agentic use · Moderation actions
Linked policy in the PR template and asked what was checked.
Added exceptions to the non-critical restriction.
Moved contribution guidance; no rule change established.
Disallowed AI authorship and required human review replies.
Simplified attribution from named tool/model to “LLM”.
Added steps to reproduce, fix and test AI-found bugs.
Replaced blanket ban with limited code assistance.
Required human-written discussion and specific disclosure.
Restricted AI replies to eligible participants; violations may lead to bans.
Relaxed how generated content can be labeled.
Revised AI contribution guidance and review safeguards.
Added accountability and refusal option; removed proof requirement.
Removed attribution; DCO and human responsibility remain.
Replaced disclosure with exclusion of AI-generated contributions.
Replaced ban with review, testing and disclosure requirements.
Added AI disclosure to bug reports.
Added AI-use disclosure and template enforcement.
